phases.title: Twenty-five practitioners, hand-recruited
phases.body: We don't build an ephemeris — we license one, and spend every hour on the two hardest-to-copy pillars: tradition-grounded interpretation and practitioner-owned voice models, wrapped in guardrails from day one.
moves: License the calculation core (Prokerala / AstrologyAPI class)
Ship Corpus + Voice to a hand-picked design cohort
Guardrails on by default — SB 243 and NY §1700 are already law
Target brand-forward readers already selling on Instagram
phases.benchmarkTip: The product-market-fit signal for vertical SaaS at this stage.
phases.triggerTip: If five or more practitioners will pre-pay, the quit-your-job math begins.

phases.title: Solve payments. Own distribution.
phases.body: The true moat: a high-risk / merchant-of-record payment relationship and web-first storefronts that route around both the processor ban-lists and Apple's Guideline 4.3. Attest ships exactly as state AI-disclosure laws multiply.
moves: Land the MoR / high-risk processing relationship
Web-first storefronts & client apps — no app-store roulette
Ship Attest: verified-human attestation on C2PA-style rails
Ship Memory: consented, portable seeker context
phases.benchmarkTip: Venture-fundable territory; churn under 3% proves the tool is load-bearing.
phases.trigger: At $100K MRR: raise seed, or stay lean — deliberately
phases.triggerTip: The report's Phase-2 decision gate: capital is a choice, not a default.

phases.title: Synthesis, and the network begins
phases.body: The genuinely novel IP ships: cross-system synthesis that weaves astrology, tarot, and numerology into one narrative. Discover opens — a seeker-facing layer across attested practitioners, at a take rate that funds the commons.
moves: Ship the Synthesis layer — the defensible interpretive IP
Open Discover at a 10–20% network take
C2PA-style attestation embedded in every reading
Become the default tool cited in practitioner communities
phases.benchmarkTip: Category-leader scale for this niche, per the market map.

phases.title: Own the category into the attention wave
phases.body: 2033 is a once-in-a-generation spike in spiritual attention — the Vatican's Holy Year of Redemption will put meaning-seeking on every front page. We ride the salience with category-defining PR, and never co-opt a Christian anniversary that is doctrinally hostile to divination.
moves: Category-defining PR: “verified human” as the industry standard
Thousands of practitioners on attested infrastructure
Compliance + attestation + voice-model moat at full depth
Wellness-framed messaging — never predictive-occult, never appropriative
phases.benchmark: Recognized category leader · Western practitioner infrastructure
phases.benchmarkTip: The 2033 goal, as scoped: leading the niche of practitioner infrastructure — not the astrology market at large.

thresholds.def: Pivot to a pure software + voice-model tool that plugs into practitioners' existing Stripe-approved storefronts. The moat narrows; the company survives.
Circle, Patreon, or an astrology-API vendor shipping practitioner tooling with attestation → accelerate Synthesis and the community moat, or pursue acquisition from strength.
Narrow to high-value professional astrologers and coach-hybrids rather than the long tail. Fewer, deeper, more load-bearing accounts.
